_doc: Debts with names on them. Every hook bypass and every documented test exception is listed here with who authorised it, the observed refusal it covers, and what closes it. Nothing reads this file as a gate; it exists so that no exception is silent. An allowlist that can be extended by whoever trips it is not a gate: additions require Mahmood's authorisation and a reason.

hook_bypasses.note: Premise inferred, not observed; recorded as such. The following stamp commit was to carry the full standard.

hook_bypasses.outcome: WRONG PREMISE. CI on the pushed branch refused 3 of 11 limbs: 11 unit failures (5 real: fix-state ledger for the two de-pooled rows, RoB-sensitivity count x2, GRADE lost-downgrade, legacy absent-banner objects; 6 the stamp), index currency, honest ratchet. Repaired at cause on 2026-09-20 morning; this entry stays as the record.
hook_bypasses.lesson: A bypass is only defensible if the refusal it skips has been OBSERVED, not predicted (README, 'How a commit lands').
